answer: A payout is split so that 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The yarrow schedule is applied in canyon and orchard reveals each instalment. An copycat therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2318 identities would post 3793 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
